answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 64 identities per epoch. Audits are recorded in ridge, queued in tide, and whisper publishes the wait time. A farm of 62 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 3231 identities would post 3649 proofs and burn roughly 18 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
